svg.desc: A terminal session: the name drawn as a dot matrix, then a short profile. Chih-Kai Wang, Taipei; Python and TypeScript tools for inspectable AI and mathematical research.

g.text: Mathematics Division, Dept. of Mathematics and Information
Education, National Taipei University of Education ·
18 projects · 4 negative results kept · 3 merged upstream
I'm a math student in Taipei. I build
small tools you can check instead of
having to trust — and now and then, short
films made entirely out of code.
Finished three works made entirely in code: ORACLE,
The Disease Called AI, and world.execute(me).
Wrote up the RuleDiff negative result as a short
technical report; the RuleShift-Web paper is still
